Top diagram "TABVLA III.": heading centred above. Brace diagram from the left label "Isaaci narrantur" to four boxes on the right: "pietas in paretem" and "proles" (with "cap.25." beside their brace), "vitae sanctimonia ... confirmata" with "cap.26.", and "prophetica ... ca.27."
"TABVLA IIII.": heading centred above. Brace diagram from the left label "Iacobi historiae narrantur in peregrinationibus" to three branches: "Mesopotamiensi" (with its sub-boxes and braces "liberorum / bonorum" and "30."), "Cenahanea" (with "profectio in Cenah. 31."), and "Ægyptiaca" (with "commoratio" and its sub-boxes).
"TABVLA V.": heading centred above. Brace diagram from the left label "Ad peregrinationē Iacobi in Ægypto pertinet" to the branches "antecedentia migrationis" (with "patefactio", "Ægyptiis", "in carcere", "extra carcerem", "suis, quum aduentu", "priore", "posteriore", "aduocatio patris"), "migratio", "commoratio", and "consequentia".

page.notes: Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible at the top right and in the lower left; not transcribed. The "TABVLA" headings are treated as level 1 divisions with caput numbers, since they are numbered tables. Some brace labels (for example "cap.25." and "cap.26.") sit beside braces and are given as their own lines. Small accents and tildes in "paretem", "Iacobū" and "consiliū suū" are read as printed and may be imperfect at this resolution.
